name: Advanced Quantum Mechanics
summary: Graduate-core quantum theory: formalism, symmetry, angular momentum, scattering, path integrals and relativistic QM.

topics.name: Hilbert spaces, Dirac notation and the postulates revisited
Pictures of time evolution: Schrodinger, Heisenberg and interaction
Symmetries and conservation laws in quantum mechanics
Rotations and the theory of angular momentum
Addition of angular momentum and Clebsch-Gordan coefficients
Tensor operators and the Wigner-Eckart theorem
Time-dependent perturbation theory and Fermi's golden rule
Adiabatic evolution and the Berry phase
Formal scattering theory: Lippmann-Schwinger, Born series and partial waves
Quantization of the electromagnetic field: photons
Relativistic quantum mechanics: Klein-Gordon and Dirac equations
Open quantum systems and quantum master equations
